q: Wave interference is the phenomenon that occurs when two waves meet while traveling along the same medium.
e: Interference အတွက် waves များသည် တူညီသော medium အတိုင်း သွားရမည်။

q: Wave interference is the phenomenon that occurs when two waves meet while traveling along different mediums.
e: Interference သည် waves များ medium မတူဘဲ သွားသောအခါမဟုတ်၊ တူညီသော medium အတိုင်း သွားသောအခါ ဖြစ်ပေါ်သည်။

q: Interference of light waves is defined as the modification in the distribution of light energy (intensity) when two or more waves superimpose each other.
e: ၎င်းသည် light wave interference ၏ အဓိပ္ပာယ်ဖွင့်ဆိုချက် အတိအကျ ဖြစ်သည်။

q: Interference of light waves is defined as the modification in the distribution of light energy (intensity) when two or more waves reflect each other.
e: Interference သည် reflection မဟုတ်ဘဲ superimposition ကြောင့် ဖြစ်သည်။

q: To observe interference of light waves, the two sources of light must be coherent with respect to each other.
e: တည်ငြိမ်သော interference pattern ထုတ်ရန် coherent sources လိုအပ်သည်။

q: To observe interference of light waves, the two sources of light must be incoherent with respect to each other.
e: interference ကို ကြည့်ရန် sources များသည် incoherent မဟုတ်ဘဲ coherent ဖြစ်ရမည်။

q: If the waves emitted from two sources have the same frequency and constant phase difference, the sources are coherent sources.
e: ၎င်းသည် coherent sources ၏ အဓိပ္ပာယ်ဖွင့်ဆိုချက် ဖြစ်သည်။

q: If the waves emitted from two sources have different frequencies and constant phase difference, the sources are coherent sources.
e: Coherent sources များသည် frequency တူညီရမည်။

q: In 1801, Thomas Young obtained convincing evidence for the wave nature of light and was able to measure wavelengths for visible light.
e: Thomas Young ၏ double-slit experiment သည် light ၏ wave nature ကို သက်သေပြခဲ့သည်။

q: In 1801, Thomas Young obtained convincing evidence for the particle nature of light and was able to measure wavelengths for visible light.
e: Young's experiment သည် light ၏ particle nature မဟုတ်ဘဲ wave nature အတွက် သက်သေ ပေးခဲ့သည်။

q: Monochromatic light (a particular wavelength) from a single source are used in his experiment.
e: Young's experiment သည် ရှင်းလင်းသော fringes ထုတ်ရန် monochromatic light ပေါ် မူတည်သည်။

q: Polychromatic light from a single source are used in his experiment.
e: experiment တွင် polychromatic မဟုတ်ဘဲ monochromatic light ကို အသုံးပြုသည်။

q: When a plane wave passes through a slit, a circular wavelet emerges from a slit because the circular wavelet is emitted from a point on the plane wave according to Huygens' principle.
e: Huygens' principle သည် slit တစ်ခုမှ circular wavelets ထွက်ပေါ်လာပုံကို ရှင်းပြသည်။

q: When a plane wave passes through a slit, a plane wavelet emerges from a slit because the plane wavelet is emitted from a point on the plane wave according to Huygens' principle.
e: slit မှ plane wavelet မဟုတ်ဘဲ circular wavelet ထွက်ပေါ်လာသည်။

q: The interference pattern is a series of bright and dark parallel lines called fringes.
e: ရလဒ် pattern သည် parallel bright နှင့် dark fringes ဖြင့် ဖွဲ့စည်းသည်။

q: The interference pattern is a series of bright and dark concentric circles called fringes.
e: pattern သည် concentric circles မဟုတ်ဘဲ parallel မျဉ်းများဖြင့် ဖွဲ့စည်းသည်။

q: Constructive interference occurs at the centre of the screen and the bright fringe appears.
e: central fringe သည် constructive interference ကြောင့် bright ဖြစ်သည်။

q: Destructive interference occurs at the centre of the screen and the bright fringe appears.
e: အလယ်တွင် constructive interference ဖြစ်ပြီး bright fringe ထွက်သည်။

q: The bright fringe at centre of the screen is called central bright line.
e: central maximum ကို central bright line ဟု ခေါ်သည်။

q: The dark fringe at centre of the screen is called central bright line.
e: central fringe သည် dark fringe မဟုတ်ဘဲ bright line ဖြစ်သည်။

q: If the path difference is equal to an integral number of wavelengths, the waves will interfere constructively, leading to a bright fringe on the screen.
e: wavelength ၏ integral path differences သည် constructive interference ဖြစ်စေသည်။

q: If the path difference is equal to a half-integral number of wavelengths, the waves will interfere constructively, leading to a bright fringe on the screen.
e: Half-integral wavelengths သည် destructive interference နှင့် dark fringes ဖြစ်စေသည်။

q: If the path difference is equal to a half-integral number of wavelengths, the waves will interfere destructively, leading to a dark fringe on the screen.
e: wavelength ၏ half-integral path differences သည် destructive interference ဖြစ်စေသည်။

q: If the path difference is equal to an integral number of wavelengths, the waves will interfere destructively, leading to a dark fringe on the screen.
e: Integral wavelengths သည် destructive မဟုတ်ဘဲ constructive interference ဖြစ်စေသည်။

q: For bright fringe to be formed at P, the path difference is equal to an integral number of wavelengths.
e: ၎င်းသည် bright fringe ဖြစ်ပေါ်ရန် အခြေအနေ ဖြစ်သည်။

q: For bright fringe to be formed at P, the path difference is equal to a half-integral number of wavelengths.
e: Half-integral wavelengths သည် bright မဟုတ်ဘဲ dark fringes ဖြစ်စေသည်။

q: The zeroth order ($m=0$) bright corresponds to the central bright line at $	heta=0$.
e: central bright line သည် zeroth order maximum ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The first-order bright ($m=1$) corresponds to the central bright line at $	heta=0$.
e: first-order မဟုတ်ဘဲ zeroth order ($m=0$) သည် central bright line နှင့် ကိုက်ညီသည်။

q: Distance between two adjacent bright (or dark) fringes is called the fringe width.
e: ၎င်းသည် fringe width ၏ အဓိပ္ပာယ်ဖွင့်ဆိုချက် အတိအကျ ဖြစ်သည်။

q: Distance between two alternate bright (or dark) fringes is called the fringe width.
e: Fringe width သည် alternate မဟုတ်ဘဲ ကပ်လျက် fringes ကြား အကွာအဝေး ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The position of fringes and fringe width depend on the wavelength of light source.
e: Fringe width သည် wavelength နှင့် directly proportional ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The position of fringes and fringe width are independent of the wavelength of light source.
e: Fringe width နှင့် အနေအထားသည် wavelength ပေါ် အလွန် မူတည်သည်။

q: Bright and dark fringes are formed alternatively where bright fringe has maximum intensity and intensity of dark fringe is zero.
e: Constructive interference သည် intensity အများဆုံးပေးပြီး destructive သည် သုည ပေးသည်။

q: Bright and dark fringes are formed alternatively where bright fringe has zero intensity and intensity of dark fringe is maximum.
e: Bright fringes တွင် intensity အများဆုံးရှိပြီး dark fringes တွင် intensity သုည ရှိသည်။
